tool_input.description: Run existing test suite and show bash version

tool_input.command: bash rotate.sh --dest /tmp --name r --keep x 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

tool_input.description: Check verify.sh exits 2 for missing dir

result:
All 9 tests pass. Both bugs are fixed and the shared code is extracted:

- **rotate.sh** — the "nothing to rotate" guard now uses `-le` (so exactly N archives are left alone), and the surplus set is now the *oldest* `total - keep` entries (`head -n`), not the newest ones (`tail -n +`).
- **verify.sh** — the sidecar line is now split with `read -r expected file` (first field = digest, rest = file name), so names containing spaces verify correctly instead of being truncated at the first space.
- **lib/common.sh** (new) — holds the shared option-parsing loop (`parse_common_options`), `is_uint`, `need_value`, KEEP validation, and `resolve_dir`; it sources `lib/log.sh` and preserves the per-script `LOG_PREFIX`. `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it and call `parse_common_options "$@"`; both keep accepting the same flags (verified: `--help`, `--keep=`, `--dry-run`, unknown-option/missing-value/positional exit codes, sidecar removal). `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.
- **tests/run_tests.sh** — added three tests: rotate with exactly N (keeps all), rotate N of N+2 (deletes oldest, keeps newest), and verify of `my backup-…tar.gz` with a space in the name.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and new `lib/common.sh`. (A temp sanity-check script remains at `/tmp/bktk_sanity.sh` — deletion there needs approval; say the word and I'll remove it.)
